headline: Most Football fans don’t care about fancy new stadiums, it’s all about traditions, history and soul of a place that make it home.
body: Thinking about this issue on the subject of clubs moving to new stadiums, going somewhere that’s more “modernised”, fancy concourses with shiny marble floors and tons of food options from Thai to Mediterranean, getting a full roast dinner with a glass of wine at halftime, padded seating, giant LED screens and whatever else. For regular fans traditional stadiums will always be more preferable, hard plastic seats, tight turnstiles, concourses colder than the arctic circle, food options being rustler burgers, bovrils or crisps, camel piss pints, bog standard coffee etc. These places that just have so much history, tradition, soul etc, lots of generations of fans for over a century have passed through the gates, you look out to the pitch and you’re just thinking about all the players throughout history have played on that grass, those big games, big moments etc. If you’ve ever been inside a stadium when it’s near on empty for an event or tour as such, you’ll know the feeling of just how much the history hits you when you look around.   submitted by   /u/GMD3S1GNS [link]   [comments]
